plugins.name: paywhere-smb
plugins.description: Small-business finance workflows (business pulse + true available cash, cash bridge, AR health / invoice chase, pay-when-due bill pay, reserve-aware payroll, sales-tax reserve check + Friday sweep, subscription audit, big-purchase + credit readiness, 13-week forecast + what-ifs, cash dashboard + Excel model, scheduled daily brief and tax-sweep agents) against Paywhere + QuickBooks + Gmail + Google Calendar. Payments stage as proposals approved on the bank's /confirm page. Includes /demo-setup.

plugins.name: paywhere-eng-workflow
plugins.description: Shared Paywhere engineering workflow: Linear-ticket-driven branch/PR flow, dependency refresh, TeamCity reconcile, production cuts, and Terraform drift triage + gated apply. Parameterised per-repo via .claude/eng-workflow.json.
